question_text: Maria is 24. She is twice as old as Ana was when Maria was as old as Ana is now. How old is Ana?

hint_ladder.title: Define Variables
hint_ladder.text: Let Ana's current age = A. The age difference between Maria and Ana is 24 - A. This difference is constant over time.

hint_ladder.title: Express the Past Situation
hint_ladder.text: When Maria was as old as Ana is now (A years old), that was (24 - A) years ago. At that time, Ana was A - (24 - A) = 2A - 24 years old.

hint_ladder.title: Set Up the Equation
hint_ladder.text: Maria now (24) is twice Ana's age at that past time: 24 = 2 × (2A - 24).

hint_ladder.title: Solve for A
hint_ladder.text: 24 = 4A - 48 → 4A = 72 → A = 18. Check: Maria is 24, Ana is 18. Difference = 6. When Maria was 18 (6 years ago), Ana was 12. 24 = 2 × 12. Correct.

A.text: You might have chosen A because this is Ana's age when Maria was 18 (6 years ago), not her current age.

B.text: You might have chosen B because of an algebraic mistake: 24 = 4A - 56 (miscalculating 24+48).

C.text: You might have chosen C because of an algebraic mistake: 4A = 64 instead of 72.

D.text: Correct. Letting Ana = A, set up 24 = 2(2A - 24), solve: 4A = 72, A = 18.

next_time_rule: Key Takeaway: In age problems with 'when X was as old as Y', use constant age difference. Let diff = d, set up and solve.
deconstruct_text:
Sa Barangay Masagana, nagplaplano sina Maria (24) at Ana para sa fiesta. Habang nagbibilang ng budget, napansin ni Maria: 'Noong ako ay nasa edad mo, ikaw ay kalahati lang ng edad ko ngayon.' Tara, solve natin gamit algebra.

Step 1: Let Ana's current age = A. Ang age difference ay 24 - A, constant 'yan.

Step 2: Noong si Maria ay A taong gulang (kasing-edad ni Ana ngayon), ilang taon na ang nakalipas? (24 - A) years ago.

Step 3: Sa panahong iyon, si Ana ay A - (24 - A) = 2A - 24 taon.

Step 4: Ngayon daw, si Maria (24) ay doble ng edad ni Ana noon: 24 = 2(2A - 24).

Step 5: Solve: 24 = 4A - 48 → 4A = 72 → A = 18.

Check: Ana ay 18, Maria 24. 6 na taon ang agwat. Noong 6 years ago, si Maria ay 18, si Ana ay 12. 24 = 2×12. Tama!

**Watch-Out Zone: past_age_confusion** in action. Huwag malito sa past age!
